status.message: Create a separate DockSlate WSL 2 runtime to use Linux Docker Engine without Docker Desktop or Rancher Desktop.

observations.dialog:
DockSlate 런타임 설치 확인

다음 대상을 새로 설치합니다.

DockSlate (new WSL 2 distribution)
D:\Program Files\DockSlate\runtime\wsl
D:\Program Files\DockSlate\runtime\ownership.json

Download Ubuntu 24.04.5 x64 WSL rootfs and verify its pinned SHA-256 before import.

Install pinned Docker Engine and CLI 29.8.2, containerd 2.3.6, Buildx 0.38.0, Compose CLI 5.6.0, curl, iptables and nftables inside the new distribution using signed official APT repositories.

Create a separate ext4.vhdx and Docker data directory owned by DockSlate. No existing Docker data is imported.

Configure systemd and a root-only Unix socket; no Docker TCP listener is created.

Stop only the newly created DockSlate distribution after setup. It remains stopped until an approved Start action.

필요한 환경

Windows 11 x64 with working WSL 2.4.10 or later.
HTTPS access to releases.ubuntu.com, official Ubuntu APT mirrors and download.docker.com.
A free DockSlate distribution name and an absent runtime target directory.
At least 4 GiB of host free space; container images and volumes use additional space.
Keep DockSlate open while setup runs. Failed imports and partial setup are preserved for inspection.
